Apply today!Your tasks may include:    - Checking products and returned items    - Processing and registering goods in the system    - Working with a computer or tablet    - Following work instructions and quality rules    - Moving goods in the warehouse    - Helping to keep the warehouse organized and safeWhat’s in it for you    - Gross hourly wage of €14.99    - Travel allowance according to the client's reimbursement scheme    - Full-time employment    - Temporary employment contract with the possibility of a direct contract with the client when performing well    - A long-term position with growth opportunities    - Pension accrual through Manpower    - Free access to more than 200 online training courses via the Manpower Academy    - An international working environment with colleagues from diverse backgrounds    - Command of the English language, both spoken and written    - Basic skills in working with computers or tablets    - Ability to spend most of the working day standing    - Availability for 40 hours per weekWould you like to start working as a Warehouse Logistics Worker at CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk? Click the apply button today and find out if this logistics opportunity matches your ambitions. We look forward to receiving your application!

Ready to hit the road and set your own schedule? 📅 As a Courier for Albert Heijn Online, you not only get guaranteed hours and maximum freedom, but you also earn an excellent salary of up to €18,83 per hour (including holiday allowance, ADV, and year-end bonus). Sounds great, right?! 💰After a full year of service, your pay even increases to €19.57 per hour! This fantastic opportunity is a real #baanrader! 🤩Apply now and you could be delivering your first order this week! 🚀 Bonus: There's even a chance for a permanent contract and plenty of paid vacation days!What we offer- Top Salary of €18,83! 💰- No less than 25 fantastic paid vacation days! 🌴- Career growth to roles like Team Leader! 🌟- Great long-term job opportunity!- Travel allowance included! 🚗💸- Flexible schedule & shift planning via app! 📱Who you areAs an Albert Heijn Online Courier, the only things we require are: that you have held your driver’s license for at least six months, and that you are available to work as a delivery driver two Saturdays per month. Furthermore:- Do you speak fluent Dutch or English?- Can you easily lift heavy grocery crates? 💪What will you doYour main mission is simple: ensure all groceries are delivered neatly and on time! As a courier, you start your shift at the distribution centre. Once you've collected your truck and route list, you hit the road! You deliver the groceries right to the customer's front door. This definitely means you'll need to flex those muscles! 💪 All set? Then it's on to the next customer! 🚀- Delivering Groceries- Customer Interaction & Service- Driving the Delivery TruckWhere will you workYou’ll be working for the most popular supermarket in the Netherlands! As a Courier for Albert Heijn Online, your shifts fall between 06:00 and 14:00 or between 13:00 and 23:00 (Monday through Saturday).
